title: Destination check: lab Postgres with the right DSN passes
summary: Checks a postgres destination with the lab DSN. The engine must log in, run SELECT 1 on a read-only session and report ok at level tested, without creating the named table.

steps.title: POST /api/v1/destinations/check
steps.explain: The real destination check the console calls before saving a destination.

steps.title: ok is true
steps.explain: The DSN is correct, so the check must pass.

steps.title: Message says SELECT 1 ran
steps.explain: The check states what it proved.

steps.title: The named table was not created
steps.explain: A check must never write to the destination.

args.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'e2e_dstcheck'

steps.title: Table count is 0
steps.explain: Nothing may be created by a check.
